subject: social_studies
concept: Completing a full independent civic capstone project from issue identification through actionable proposal and personal commitment, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 social studies sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student compiles their full capstone across issue/research/channel/proposal/objection/reflection stages
exercise.abstract: Student completes an independent civic capstone: a real community issue, multi-stakeholder research, a legitimate civic channel, an actionable proposal, an addressed obstacle, and a personal engagement commitment

assessment.mastery_threshold: capstone demonstrates all stages cohering into one complete, realistic civic action plan
misconception_flags: completes individual stages competently but the final capstone doesn't cohere into one realistic civic plan

interest_binding: full capstone issue generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
